claim: The new reportDiagnostic wrapper drops every diagnostic whose Location is not IsInSource in the compilation. Diagnostics created with a null location (Location.None) are now silently discarded, and so are diagnostics in a different tree. Previously any diagnostic reported through reportDiagnostic reached the user. Existing no-location diagnostics, for example ones built with GetLocation(...) that returns null, could vanish from users' builds. This hides MsgPack003/004/005 errors (per L2), which could turn a failing build into a passing one. Note that L8 only says metadata types get no diagnostics.

claim: MemberNeedsKey (MsgPack004) used to use item.DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0].GetSyntax().GetLocation(). It now uses FirstOrDefault()?.GetSyntax().GetLocation(), which can be null. Diagnostic.Create with a null location yields a no-location diagnostic. The wrapper then drops it (not IsInSource), so MsgPack004 is never reported. Behaviour for in-source members is unchanged, but the guard hides the diagnostic silently instead of crashing.
